Alpha Vantage API Documentation

Time Series Data

This category provides access to real-time and historical time series data for stocks, ETFs, and digital currencies. All data is delivered in JSON format and includes intraday, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.

TIME_SERIES_DAILY

This API returns daily time series data.

Python Example

import requests

url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo'
response = requests.get(url)
data = response.json()

print(data)

R Example

library(httr)

url <- 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo'
response <- GET(url)
data <- content(response, "parsed")

print(data)

Excel VBA Example

Sub GetStockData()
    Dim url As String
    Dim xmlHttp As Object
    Dim response As String

    url = "https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo"

    Set xmlHttp = CreateObject("MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP")
    xmlHttp.Open "GET", url, False
    xmlHttp.send

    response = xmlHttp.responseText
    MsgBox response
End Sub

MATLAB Example

function data = getStockData(symbol)
    url = sprintf('https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=%s&apikey=demo', symbol);

    options = weboptions('Timeout', 30);
    data = webread(url, options);

    disp(data);
end

GLOBAL_QUOTE

This API returns the latest price and volume information for a given stock symbol.

Python Example

import requests
import json

def get_quote(symbol, api_key):
    base_url = "https://www.alphavantage.co/query"
    params = {
        "function": "GLOBAL_QUOTE",
        "symbol": symbol,
        "apikey": api_key
    }

    response = requests.get(base_url, params=params)

    if response.status_code == 200:
        return response.json()
    else:
        return {"error": f"API request failed with status {response.status_code}"}

# Example usage
quote = get_quote("AAPL", "your_api_key")
print(json.dumps(quote, indent=2))
